description: the main window's server wallet (components/BillingPanel.jsx, behind VITE_BILLING_UI) opens Stripe Checkout in the system browser through the opener plugin. Only https://checkout.stripe.com URLs (session URLs end in a #fragment, hence the second pattern); nothing else, no open-path. Without this, openUrl from the main window is denied (default.json grants no opener permission; strip.json covers only the strip window).
